scoring_justification: T0 result-level compare against paper Table 1 values with tolerances; T1 recompute from raw phonon outputs not feasible because the agent does not submit the full phonon frequency list, only the identified mode wavenumbers and shifts.

hidden_assets.purpose: HIDDEN gold wavenumbers and blue shifts from paper Table 1 (unit: cm⁻¹)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 (DFT calculation results of untwisted bilayer BP and twisted bilayer BP)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values copied directly from the paper's printed Table 1; paper is the authoritative source.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual DFT-computed numbers reported in the peer-reviewed publication; they serve as the reference reproduction target.

outputs.description: Scored artifact containing the main DFT phonon wavenumbers and shifts.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares reported values to the paper's Table 1 values with tolerances (hidden) for each wavenumber and shift. The blue shifts carry higher weight in scoring.
